purpose: Separate physical readout interfaces from process monitoring so the intended instrument can be specified without equating water delivery or a clear window with scientific measurement.
status: interface design basis; no research-use, geometry or manufacturing release
engineering_decisions: Keep reusable dry support, commercial replaceable wetted path and readout-specific replaceable insert as distinct assemblies. Do not clamp an unsupported coverslip or use printed material as an electrode/seal.
Preserve the active A0 geometry. Any changed support/window/readout route requires explicit integration review and the normal geometry-release flow.
Keep process observations separate from scientific readout; no automatic clinical or cure inference from either.
Do not add a microscope, impedance analyzer, electrode PCB or environmental controller to the purchase list until its complete vessel/interface requirements are matched.

envelope_comparison.basis: nominal published envelope placed concentrically for comparison only; not an actual supported pose
envelope_comparison.finding: The entire nominal slide outline falls inside the A0 optical opening in this assumed pose. The opening is not a slide support. Geometry containment establishes neither seating nor a usable objective approach.
not_evaluated: objective barrel/nosepiece sweep and working distance

a0_window_reference.finding: This placeholder is above the lid in the recorded assembly, not a coverslip underneath a replacement slide. Whether a chosen optical path intersects it must be established from the actual stack. No claim that the existing panel blocks every inverted path.
